flashcard_questions.q: What is reconciliation after a conflict?
flashcard_questions.a: Restoring harmony between people who have been in conflict, rebuilding trust.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do some Christians separate forgiveness from reconciliation?
flashcard_questions.a: A victim can forgive an attacker without re-establishing a relationship with them.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Qur’an verse says whoever pardons and makes peace has their reward with Allah?
Which of Allah’s names means “the Most Merciful”?
Which of Allah’s names means “the Just”?
Which month especially encourages Muslims to seek and grant forgiveness?
Who was Gee Walker, mother of Anthony Walker?
flashcard_questions.a: A devout Christian who publicly forgave her son’s killers.

flashcard_questions.q: What did Gee Walker say about feeling anger and hatred?
flashcard_questions.a: She could not feel them, because that is what killed her son.

flashcard_questions.q: Who chaired South Africa’s Truth and Reconciliation Commission?
What did the Truth and Reconciliation Commission offer perpetrators?
flashcard_questions.a: Amnesty in exchange for a full confession of their crimes.

flashcard_questions.q: What did Desmond Tutu say about forgiveness and the future?
flashcard_questions.a: Without forgiveness, there is no future.

flashcard_questions.q: How did the Amish community respond to the 2006 school shooting?
flashcard_questions.a: They forgave the killer and set up a charitable fund for his family.
It promotes human well-being and reduces suffering.

flashcard_questions.q: What argument do some non-religious people make against forgiving a criminal?
flashcard_questions.a: Where there is no genuine remorse, pardoning can seem unjust to the victim.

flashcard_questions.q: How does Islamic teaching on forgiveness differ from Christian teaching?
flashcard_questions.a: Islam also permits proportionate justice as a legitimate alternative.

notes: 15 cards: 3 term→definition (reconciliation, Ar-Rahman, Al-Adl), 1 belief→source (Qur’an 42:40), 4 case studies (Gee Walker ×2, Tutu/TRC ×2, Amish), 3 argument→view (humanist, non-religious objection, Islamic contrast), 2 concept cards (forgiveness vs reconciliation, Ramadan). Built on the case studies so it does not repeat the sister Forgiveness lesson’s scripture cards.
